Name: Sebastian Sprites based on Zhiyu's Portraits
Author: AutoGeneral
Description:
Hi!!! I began this project just for myself because Zhiyu's portraits for Sebastian didn't have any sprites that matched the look and i really wanted it to feel like it was meant to be there but i realized some other people might want this too. I have winter and the beach sprite set up so dw about that. only thing with the winter sprite is i have yet to change the event sprites to the winter one but I don't know if I'm going to do that unless people ask!! it's just a small immersion break. this is my first time making a sprite based on someone else's work and tbh first time even completing a sprite mod, i made only a few alterations so seb feels more alive! The wedding sprite is completely my idea :)

For the sprites to look correct  i really recommend downloading the portraits i based them off of. They are Zhiyu's creation and very cute!!
[quote]﻿[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19233]Zhiyu's Portraits[/url]﻿[/quote]
IF YOU ARE ZHIYU AND WANT TO ASK FOR ALTERCATIONS OR REMOVAL OF THE MOD PLEASE DM ME!!

I'm thinking of doing other sprites for different characters, both modded and not, if you have any ideas or other portraits u CRAVEEE sprites for let me know!
